# tools: try atuin

Try [atuin](https://atuin.sh/) ([source](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin)), the shell history replacement: SQLite-backed, searchable with context (directory, exit code, duration), optionally synced between machines end-to-end encrypted. **Motivation:** "improve developer experience with shell" — and, with three Macs, a shared history.
